caption: The drawing features a single elongated, bulbous object resembling a vessel or bottle, which tapers from a wide, rounded end to a narrower, cylindrical neck. The neck has a pair of circular rings encircling it near the transition to the main body. The vessel is decorated with a pattern of swirling, wave-like bands in shades of brown, reddish-brown, and beige, creating a marbled appearance throughout the surface. The mouth at the narrower end appears slightly flared, while the opposite end forms a rounded base with a small, red-brown circular protrusion at the tip. The object is depicted against a plain, light beige background without any other elements or ornamentation.
title: Powder Horn
